description.en: How has the erotic been deployed as a colonial and racializing technology? How might the erotic scramble, however fleetingly and flimsily, the coherence of racialized and colonial relations? Lingering with this dialectic of ab/use, we consider how the erotic has been aesthetically and theoretically taken up—not despite but precisely because of the violence that haunts it.
